metric_definition: A token is controlled when it resolves to the educator-cleared prerequisite core, an explicitly taught Unit-01 target, a verified A1 pedagogical support item, a transparent clitic/inflection alias resolving to one of those categories, or an allowed proper name. This metric is not a learner-mastery estimate.
raw_analyzer_policy: Stanza inventory/rank diagnostics are retained as conservative diagnostics only. Arabic tokenization, clitic segmentation, and inflection/lemmatization misses are not counted as uncontrolled vocabulary when the surface is independently resolved to a verified controlled base.
approval_note: Supported lexical control is cleared for all six Arabic A1 Unit-01 passages. Canonical passage quality/status fields remain a separate persistence step and must not be inferred from this audit alone.
